summary: Move explorer services and releases into the independent usdb-explorer repository
details: Move browser deployment, the RPC gateway and their tests to usdb-explorer, with independent semantic-version tags and CI.
Export pinned USDB network identity and RPC requirements instead of importing a sibling node checkout during explorer builds.
Preserve the legacy v0.1.0 assets and a pinned legacy publisher; reject new public tag preparation in the node release tool.
Keep legacy CLI compatibility, configuration and deployment schemas, storage paths, credentials and volume identity during the first explorer upgrade.
operator_actions: Use buckyos/usdb-explorer for future browser builds and releases; existing node release tags and compatibility locks remain independent.
